why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Get an invite code. RISEx is in gated mainnet, and codes come from existing traders, the team or the waitlist referral leaderboard.
Go to rise.trade , click Trade Now and sign in with Google or an EVM wallet.
Enter the code, enable trading and switch to the RISE network.
Deposit USDC from your wallet or to a deposit address.
Trade. Your balance updates after each weekly drop on the points page .
costs: At the base fee tier takers pay 0.03% and makers 0.01%, with discounts at higher 14-day volume. The Fees page of the RISE docs on 18 October 2026, with a fee schedule by 14-day volume tier. Source: RISE docs Warning Because fees and slippage count toward points, more points generally means paying more to trade.
